featured_reviews.review_text:
I wish I could give this place zero stars. Firstly, the massage, just to be clear, is 45 minutes at best and then they include a 15 minute shower in that 60 mins. This is stated nowhere when you schedule the appointment. The massage was mediocre at best. I feel bad for the young women who do seven or eight of these a day. They are untrained massage therapists who are most likely overworked and underpaid. Perhaps the most disturbing thing that happened with my husband is that when he went  for his massage, the young woman who was massaging him
asked him if he would like a happy ending. My husband was alarmed and immediately asked to be switched to a different type of massage and masseuse. It was VERY clear that all three of us were asking for Swedish massages. We went back to the management and tried to tell them about it and basically the manager turned it around and said that how do you know that my husband wasn’t trying to solicit her? What a deplorable act of turning this situation around to cover up the shady practices happening in this business. An absolutely disgusting way to run a business and there is no recourse!  I would report them to the police but the manager was cocky, defensive, and immensely corrupt and probably would bribe the police. In short, he was an absolute and complete bully.

I would also check if they have hidden cameras in the room. We went back and checked but it’s not impossible to hide cameras nowadays in virtually any place. Unless you are actually wanting sexual favors, I would stay away from this place. I suspect the google reviews are made up. What a disgusting abhorrent establishment! The person at the front desk was complicit in this as he too didn’t make eye contact. Illegal trafficking of women is not uncommon in many parts of the world but it was astounding to see it happen before our eyes. I would stay away from this business!  I know the owner will respond with what he said to us in person that how do we know my husband didn’t initiate it, but this is just another way to cover up their shady practices. If he wanted a “happy ending”, he would have gotten one, but he went for a legal Swedish massage. I feel bad for these poor women who have to do this to survive. Despicable and disgusting business!
